title: FordPass Vehicle Fuel or SOC Leaderboard
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fordpass:vehicle fuel_or_soc_pct=*
| stats sum(fuel_or_soc_pct) as total_value, avg(fuel_or_soc_pct) as avg_value by vehicle_nickname
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks vehicle values by total and average fuel or soc across FordPass vehicle events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `fuel_or_soc_pct` values for each FordPass vehicle event and review total and average fuel or soc by vehicle.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total fuel or soc.
grandmaExplanation: It honestly which vehicle shows the biggest fuel or soc numbers in your FordPass vehicle data.
